integrity: General proof is internal and mathematical; direct exhaustive checks for eight configurations are corroborative, not proof for all finite fields or graphs. Independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite loopless quivers and radical-square-zero path algebras only; arrow loops and nonzero length-two paths excluded. Exact centralizer cardinalities, not centralizer-set classifications. The Fortuin-Kasteleyn specialization is classical; a two-vertex Kronecker specialization of the commuting probability already appears in an earlier published research record. No independent publication-priority certification.
title: Adjoint-rank enumeration and the vertex-arboricity threshold for radical-square-zero quiver algebras
